race.comment: CLENCH (2) gets the nod third-up, mainly because this distance really plays to his strengths: one win and one placing from two tries around 1900m. His Taree BM58 fifth was only fair and he was unwanted in the market, but it was a better platform than his heavy-track Open here. Can give this a shake. OAKFIELD NEVADA (8) has upside third-up for Kris Lees, with two recent Mdn runs on soft ground close enough to keep her right in this. EINSTEIN'S THEORY (6) was only beaten four and a half lengths in a Port Mac Mdn and beat OAKFIELD NEVADA there, so he is in the mix if the longer trip helps. YIANNI (5) brings the fresh winning form after taking a Murwillumbah Mdn by just over a length, though this is a harder meeting.
